name: fpl-intelligence
description: Fantasy Premier League analysis: captain picks, transfer suggestions, fixture difficulty, differentials, price predictions, mini-league tracking, and a full manager intelligence report.
long_description: An MCP server backed by live data from the official FPL API. A single static Go binary — no API keys, no hosted service, no per-request cost. Each user runs their own copy against the free, public FPL API.

prompts.name: analyze_my_fpl_team
prompts.description: Comprehensive analysis of an FPL manager's team — squad health, captain pick, transfers, fixtures, and price risks.
prompts.text:
Use the fpl_manager_hub tool with team_id ${arguments.team_id} to pull a full intelligence report for my FPL team. Then give me a comprehensive analysis covering:
1. Squad health — any injured, doubtful, or poor-form starters I should worry about
2. Captain recommendation — who should I captain and why
3. Transfer priorities — which players should I sell and who are the best replacements
4. Fixture outlook — which of my players have great or terrible upcoming fixtures
5. Price change risks — am I about to lose value on anyone
6. Overall verdict — a 1-paragraph summary of my team's state and the single most important action to take this gameweek

prompts.name: find_differential_picks
prompts.description: Find underowned gems that most FPL managers are missing.
prompts.text:
Use the differential_finder tool with max_ownership_pct ${arguments.max_ownership} to find underowned players who are outperforming their ownership. Then:
- Highlight the top 3 differentials I should seriously consider
- For each one, explain WHY they're flying under the radar
- Rate their upcoming fixtures
- Tell me if they're a short-term punt or a long-term hold
- Flag any risks (rotation, tough fixtures coming, underlying stats not matching output)
I want players that can give me a real rank boost.

prompts.name: plan_my_transfers
prompts.description: Get transfer suggestions based on your current squad and upcoming fixtures.
prompts.text:
Use the transfer_suggestions tool with team_id ${arguments.team_id} to analyze my squad and suggest transfers. Then walk me through the plan:
1. Who are the weakest links in my squad and why?
2. What are the best replacements and what makes them better?
3. Should I take a hit (-4 points) for an extra transfer or save it?
4. Are any suggested transfers also good for upcoming fixture swings?
5. Are any targets about to rise in price (buy now vs. wait)?
Give me a clear action plan: exactly which transfers to make and in what order.

prompts.name: price_change_alert
prompts.description: Check which players are about to rise or fall in price tonight.
prompts.text:
Use the price_predictions tool to check tonight's likely price changes. Then give me a briefing:
- Which players are most likely to RISE in price tonight?
- Which players are most likely to FALL?
- Do I need to rush any transfers through before the price change?
- Are any of the risers worth buying even if I wasn't planning a transfer?
- Are any of the fallers players I should panic-sell?
Keep it actionable — tell me exactly what to do before tonight's deadline.

prompts.name: who_should_i_captain
prompts.description: Get captain pick recommendations with detailed reasoning for this gameweek.
prompts.text:
Use the captain_pick tool to get the top 5 captain recommendations for this gameweek. Then explain the results to me in plain English:
- Who is the #1 pick and why?
- What makes them stand out (xG, fixtures, form, penalties)?
- Is there a high-risk high-reward differential captain option?
- Any injury flags or rotation risks I should be aware of?
Give me a clear final recommendation with your confidence level.

weights_url.title: Optimized weights URL (advanced)
weights_url.description: Only relevant if you run a private data-driven weights endpoint (see internal/remoteweights). Leave blank — every user without one gets the same hand-tuned default scoring.

weights_access_client_id.title: Weights endpoint Access Client ID (advanced)
weights_access_client_id.description: Cloudflare Access service token Client ID for the URL above. Leave blank unless you set weights_url.

weights_access_client_secret.title: Weights endpoint Access Client Secret (advanced)
weights_access_client_secret.description: Cloudflare Access service token Client Secret for the URL above. Leave blank unless you set weights_url.

apifootball_key.title: API-Football key (optional)
apifootball_key.description: Your own key from api-football.com (a free plan works). Adds bookmaker-implied clean-sheet chance and expected goals to fixture_outlook. Leave blank to skip; nothing else changes.
